# Nagdev Products Private Limited

> Operational castor oil crushing, refining, and specialty oleochemical derivatives manufacturer located in North Gujarat's castor belt (Vav-Tharad district), India.

## Company Overview
- Legal Corporate Name: Nagdev Products Private Limited
- Corporate Identity Number (CIN): U15400GJ2019PTC110518
- Incorporated: 2019, Gujarat, India
- Operational Crushing Facility: 50 TPD mechanical expeller crushing, semi-continuous oil refining, and derivative reactors
- Plant Address: Survey No. 301 P-2, Jada-Kotarwada Road, Village Sardarpura, Taluka Deodar, District Vav-Tharad, Gujarat 385330, India
- Head Office: 612, 6th Floor, Sharan Circle Hub, SP Ring Road, Zundal, Gandhinagar 382421, Gujarat, India
- Export Ports: Kandla Port (Deendayal) & Mundra Port (Gulf of Kutch)

## Commercial Product Range (32 Products)

### Regular Supply (7 Commercial Volume Grades)
- [Commercial Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/commercial-castor-oil): Industrial-grade unrefined castor oil (CAS 8001-79-4) for lubricants, alkyds, and industrial synthesis.
- [First Special Grade Castor Oil (FSG)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/first-special-grade-castor-oil): Refined, bleached, low-acidity castor oil (CAS 8001-79-4, FFA < 1.0%) for polyurethanes, pharma precursors, and coatings.
- [First Pressed Degummed (FPD)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/fpd-castor-oil): Water-degummed primary extraction oil (CAS 8001-79-4) for industrial feedstock and polyols.
- [Castor Cake (Organic Fertilizer)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/castor-cake): Nitrogen-rich expeller de-oiled meal (4.5%–5.5% N) with nematicidal ricin active for commercial agriculture.
- [Hydrogenated Castor Oil (HCO / Castor Wax)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/hydrogenated-castor-oil): Hard vegetable wax flakes (CAS 8001-78-3, Drop Point 85°C–88°C) for lithium greases, powder coatings, and sealants.
- [Dehydrated Castor Oil (DCO)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dehydrated-castor-oil): Fast-drying conjugated diene oil (CAS 64147-40-6) for alkyd resins, baking enamels, and printing inks.
- [DCO Fatty Acid](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dco-fatty-acid): Conjugated diene fatty acid (CAS 61789-45-5) for clear-drying stoving alkyds and heavy-duty finishes.

### Available on Technical Enquiry (8 Specialized Grades)
- [Pale Pressed Grade (PPG)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/ppg-castor-oil): Low-color high-purity grade (CAS 8001-79-4) for pale alkyds and specialty coatings.
- [Cold Pressed Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/cold-pressed-castor-oil): Virgin single-press mechanical extraction (CAS 8001-79-4) for personal care and high-purity formulations.
- [Castor Oil BP (British Pharmacopoeia grade)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/castor-oil-bp93): Monograph-tested pharmacopoeia grade (CAS 8001-79-4) for excipients and topical preparations.
- [Castor Oil USP–NF](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/castor-oil-usp-nf): United States Pharmacopeia–National Formulary compendial grade (CAS 8001-79-4) for oral and topical formulations.
- [Castor Oil Ph. Eur.](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/castor-oil-ph-eur): European Pharmacopoeia compendial grade (CAS 8001-79-4) for pharmaceutical and cosmetic applications.
- [Castor Oil IP](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/castor-oil-ip): Indian Pharmacopoeia compendial grade (CAS 8001-79-4) for medical and therapeutic uses.
- [Castor Oil JP](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/castor-oil-jp): Japanese Pharmacopoeia compendial grade (CAS 8001-79-4) for Japanese regulatory compliance.
- [Cosmetic Grade Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/cosmetic-grade-castor-oil): Low-odor, bleached cosmetic oil (CAS 8001-79-4) for color cosmetics, lip care, and emulsions.

### Advanced Derivatives & Co-Products (17 Under R&D Development)
- [Ricinoleic Acid](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/ricinoleic-acid): 85%+ pure hydroxy fatty acid (CAS 141-22-0, under development) for ester synthesis and surfactants.
- [12-Hydroxystearic Acid (12-HSA)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/12-hydroxystearic-acid): Primary gelling fatty acid (CAS 106-14-9, under development) for automotive and industrial lithium greases.
- [Refined Glycerin 99.5%](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/refined-glycerin): High-purity pure vegetable glycerol (CAS 56-81-5, under development) from derivative co-product streams.
- [Crude Glycerin 80%](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/crude-glycerin): Co-product glycerol stream (CAS 56-81-5, under development) for industrial distillation.
- [High Protein Castor Meal](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/high-protein-castor-meal): High-nitrogen organic soil conditioner (CAS 68424-10-2, under development) for horticultural enrichment.
- [Sodium Sulphate Anhydrous](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/sodium-sulphate-anhydrous): Inorganic salt co-product (CAS 7757-82-6, under development) for detergent builders.
- [Sebacic Acid](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/sebacic-acid): C10 dicarboxylic acid (CAS 111-20-6, under development) for bio-polyamides (Nylon 6.10, Nylon 10.10) and synthetic diesters.
- [Bio-Polyurethane Polyols](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/bio-polyurethane-polyols): Tailored OH-value renewable polyols (CAS 68442-88-6, under development) for rigid/flexible PU foams and CASE.
- [Dioctyl Sebacate (DOS)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dioctyl-sebacate): Low-temperature synthetic diester plasticizer (CAS 122-62-3, under development) for aerospace rubbers and PVC.
- [Dibutyl Sebacate (DBS)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dibutyl-sebacate): Specialty plasticizer ester (CAS 109-43-3, under development) for cellulose and flexible specialty polymers.
- [Lithium 12-Hydroxystearate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/lithium-12-hydroxystearate): Pre-reacted lithium soap powder (CAS 7620-77-1, under development) for grease compounding.
- [Calcium 12-Hydroxystearate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/calcium-12-hydroxystearate): Specialty pre-reacted soap (CAS 3159-62-4, under development) for water-resistant industrial greases.
- [Zinc Ricinoleate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/zinc-ricinoleate): Natural odor-trapping coordinated active salt (CAS 13040-19-2, under development) for deodorants.
- [Zinc Undecylenate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/zinc-undecylenate): Antifungal fatty acid zinc salt (CAS 557-08-4, under development) for footcare and topical powders.
- [Methyl Ricinoleate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/methyl-ricinoleate): Low-viscosity methyl ester (CAS 141-24-2, under development) for diesel lubricity and chemical synthesis.
- [Methyl 12-Hydroxystearate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/methyl-12-hydroxystearate): Hydroxy ester intermediate (CAS 141-23-1, under development) for synthetic waxes and lithium soaps.
- [Blown Oxidized Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/blown-oxidized-castor-oil): High-viscosity polymerized fluid (CAS 68187-84-8, under development) for printing inks and hydraulic plasticizers.
